Open PRs matching "expression conformance ledger app.zod" → 0.

## What fails

`main`'s scheduled CI (full battery) is red on `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)`, and the aggregator `Dogfood Regression Gate` reports `dogfood-3-of-3 published no positive attestation`.

| Run | Head | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [39315781843](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39315781843) · 20:01Z | `35450f0732` (#24628's merge) | red: 2 failed / 878 passed |
| 21:01Z, 22:01Z | `f89d29e38`, `cc95f5e63` | red |
| [39338859206](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/actions/runs/39338859206) · 23:01Z | `7c509c286f` | red, same two tests |

The last green scheduled run was 19:01Z on `b12e16a56`.

Both failures are in `packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.test.ts`, "ADR-0058 D7 — expression surface conformance ledger":

1. "is a sound conformance ledger + ratchet (ADR-0060 checkLedger)" (`:426`) gets nine `UNCLASSIFIED surface — add a ledger row (ADR-0060)` rows:
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:NavigationContributionSchema.history`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:NavigationContributionSchema.items`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:AppBrandingSchema.history`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:NavigationAreaSchema.history`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:NavigationAreaSchema.navigation`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:AppContextSelectorSchema.history`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:AppSchema.history`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:AppSchema.navigation`
   - `ui/app.zod.ts:AppSchema.apis`
2. "every declaring POSITION has its own ratchet key — no silent collapse" (`:518`) gets `ui/app.zod.ts:AppContextSelectorSchema.history: 3 declaring positions share ONE ratchet key ... ui/app.zod.ts:1466, ui/app.zod.ts:1494, ui/app.zod.ts:1522`.

## Why it is #24628

- In `b12e16a56..35450f0732`, the only commit that touches `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` is #24628 (`35450f0732`), and the red first shows on that commit's own scheduled run. `git log b12e16a56..origin/main -- packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts packages/qa/dogfood/test/expression-conformance.test.ts` lists only it.
- Its diff adds the file's one new reference to `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`: a `.safeParse` call inside the module-private `authoredVisibleEnvelope` (`app.zod.ts:1026`–`1027` on `35450f0732`).
- The nine positions the ledger names are object keys (`history`, `items`, `navigation`, `apis`) that declare no expression. At `:1466`, `:1494` and `:1522` they are the `history` strings of the strict-object guidance blocks.
- Not measured: whether the scanner attributes that call to these keys. The likely reading is a declaring position read from a call site, but that has not been run. The claimant measures it first: run the test on `35450f0732` with `authoredVisibleEnvelope` inlined or removed.

## Done when

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test -- test/expression-conformance.test.ts` passes on `main`, and the next scheduled full battery's `Dogfood Regression Gate (3/3)` is green.
- No ledger row classifies a position that declares no expression. A fix that adds the nine rows as they are would record a false surface; the claimant shows the rows are real before adding any.
